name: doai-workbench
description: DoAI Workbench 桌面壳：Electron 把 agent-cluster serve 后端与 React 工作台前端串成桌面应用

scripts.sync:frontend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve(__dirname, '../frontend/dist'); const dst=path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist-frontend'); fs.rmSync(dst, {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync(src, dst, {recursive: true}); console.log('Frontend synced to desktop/dist-frontend');"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run sync:frontend
